purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche P benchmark authored only after r26 production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded; it was not used to construct r26.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production verification of r26 and was not used to construct r26.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N/O player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: normally just one action total for the turn?
expectedSourceGroups: The active player normally takes one Action total during the turn

cases.question: tiebreak roll ignores advantage, modifiers, and old battle totals?
expectedSourceGroups: Do not apply advantage, disadvantage, card effects, numerical modifiers, or the previous battle totals

cases.question: forced march extra move can't start a battle?
expectedSourceGroups: This additional movement cannot initiate a battle

cases.question: hold the line and i lose: after retreat they capture that territory?
expectedSourceGroups: If you lose, after you retreat, the attacker captures that Territory

cases.question: insurrection action: dump hand, both recycle discard, then i get 3 cards +1 action?
expectedSourceGroups: Discard your Hand. Each player shuffles their Discard Pile into their Draw Pile. +3 Cards. +1 Action

cases.question: intercepted orders can reveal their reserve and lock one card out for the battle?
expectedSourceGroups: reveal that Reserve and choose 1 card they cannot choose this battle

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, if you discard the banked Asset when they form their Reserve before Tactics are chosen.

cases.question: invasion gives up to 2 extra positions but only advancing?
expectedSourceGroups: advance up to two additional Positions
may only be used to advance

cases.question: martyrdom after i lose: remaining enemy reserve goes grave and my conviction becomes 4?
expectedSourceGroups: cards remaining in the opponent's Reserve in their Graveyard instead of their Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, when Martyrdom is legally played as its Aftermath Reaction.

cases.question: palisade wall on defense: discard it in onset to shut off their assets for the battle?
expectedSourceGroups: During Onset while you are the defender, you may discard this card to make the opponent's Assets inactive during that battle

cases.question: reconnaissance on my attack: reveal their hand, then i can withdraw or keep going?
expectedSourceGroups: reveal the opponent's Hand. You may then withdraw or continue the attack

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, by discarding banked Reconnaissance during Onset.

cases.question: reserve force bound tactic gets played after tactics reveal and goes grave in aftermath?
expectedSourceGroups: play the bound card as a Tactic. Put it in your Graveyard in the Aftermath

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, if you discard Reserve Force to use the bound card.

cases.question: revolution: i ditch 4, they ditch 2, so i draw 2 and they draw 4?
expectedSourceGroups: draws cards equal to the number of cards the other player discarded

cases.question: discard reinforcements in denouement for +1 action, so that extra action is usable right there in denouement?
expectedSourceGroups: During Opening or Denouement, discard this card: +1 Action
+N Action grants N additional Actions during the current phase

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The +1 Action is available in the current Denouement phase.

cases.question: sedition forces one of my assets out. decoys can save it because that's Removal?
expectedSourceGroups: If an opposing effect would Remove one or more of your other Assets, you may discard this card to keep one of them in play
An Asset is Removed whenever a rule or effect forces it to leave play

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Sedition's forced discard is Removal, so Decoys can be discarded to keep that other Asset in play.
